skill.name: api-documenter
skill.description: Create and improve API documentation with OpenAPI 3.1, interactive developer portals, SDK guidance, and maintenance workflows.
skill.summary: Guide API documentation from specifications to developer portals, SDK examples, testing, and version maintenance.
skill.author: sickn33

content.value_statement: API teams often struggle to keep specifications, examples, and portals accurate. This skill guides OpenAPI documentation, developer portals, SDK examples, and maintenance workflows.
actual_capabilities: Drafts and reviews OpenAPI 3.1 and AsyncAPI specifications with examples and auth flows.
Plans developer portals, navigation, onboarding flows, and API explorer experiences.
Generates documentation outlines for SDKs, webhooks, migration guides, and error references.
Suggests testing and validation workflows for examples, schemas, and curl commands.
Creates maintenance guidance for versioning, changelogs, deprecations, and release notes.
limitations: Does not verify live API behavior without provided tests, specs, or service access.
Does not replace security review for authentication, authorization, or credential handling.
Requires accurate API details to avoid incomplete endpoints, schemas, or examples.
May need tool-specific adjustment for Mintlify, Redoc, Swagger UI, or Docusaurus.

use_cases.title: Launch REST API Docs
use_cases.description: Create specifications, endpoint references, quick starts, auth guidance, and examples for a new public API.

use_cases.title: Improve Developer Portal
use_cases.description: Audit navigation, onboarding, search, examples, feedback paths, and analytics for an existing documentation site.

use_cases.title: Plan API Version Migration
use_cases.description: Design migration guides, deprecation notices, changelogs, SDK notes, and validation plans for breaking changes.

prompt_templates.title: Create API Documentation Outline
prompt_templates.prompt: I am documenting a REST API. Help me define target users, required pages, endpoint reference structure, and a first-pass OpenAPI checklist.

prompt_templates.title: Review an OpenAPI Spec
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this OpenAPI 3.1 specification for missing examples, authentication clarity, schema issues, and developer onboarding gaps. Prioritize changes by impact.

prompt_templates.title: Build Developer Portal Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a developer portal for multiple APIs. Include navigation, onboarding paths, API explorer needs, SDK documentation, feedback channels, and maintenance workflow.

prompt_templates.title: Create Migration and Testing Strategy
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a version migration guide and documentation testing plan for an API v1 to v2 upgrade. Cover breaking changes, examples, validation, and rollout.

output_examples.input: Create a first documentation plan for a public REST API.
output: A target-audience summary and success criteria.
A page map for overview, authentication, endpoint reference, errors, SDKs, and support.
An OpenAPI readiness checklist for schemas, examples, and auth flows.

output_examples.input: Improve an existing developer portal with low adoption.
output: A portal audit covering navigation, search, onboarding, examples, and API explorer friction.
Recommendations for quick starts, feedback collection, analytics, and content ownership.
A migration-guide structure with breaking changes, timelines, compatibility notes, and testing expectations.
A release communication plan for deprecation notices and SDK updates.

best_practices: Start from real developer journeys before writing reference pages.
Keep examples, schemas, and auth instructions tied to tested behavior.
Assign ownership for versioning, deprecation notices, analytics, and content updates.
anti_patterns: Publishing generated reference docs without onboarding, examples, or error guidance.
Documenting authentication after endpoints instead of making access clear early.
Treating documentation as complete when SDKs, changelogs, and migration paths are missing.

faq.question: What does this skill help create?
faq.answer: It helps create API specs, references, onboarding guides, SDK docs, portals, and migration content.

faq.question: Does it support OpenAPI 3.1?
faq.answer: Yes. It focuses on OpenAPI 3.1 and can also guide AsyncAPI and GraphQL documentation.

faq.question: Can it generate SDKs?
faq.answer: It can plan SDK generation and documentation from specs, but actual generation depends on your chosen tools.

faq.question: Does it test live APIs?
faq.answer: No. It can suggest validation and testing plans, but you must run tests in your environment.

faq.question: Is it safe to use for private APIs?
faq.answer: Yes, if you avoid sharing secrets and provide only the details needed for documentation.

faq.question: Who should use it?
faq.answer: API engineers, technical writers, developer relations teams, and platform teams can use it for documentation workflows.
